# Mini Season: Summer Sock Hop (July 2026)

![Mini Season: Summer Sock Hop (July 2026)](/uploads/726_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Another new mini season is upon us. The Summer Sock Hop Mini Season has already been announced in the community calendar. So far, the challenges and rewards are not included in the data for the live version. This means we will receive the Mid Season Live Patch before the start of this mini season.

### Mini season period

**Tue, July 21st, 2026 (6:00 p.m.) - Tue, August 4th, 2026 (6:00 p.m.)**

This mini season will also have a new area next to the season. If you press "Season" in the main menu, a selection will open where you can choose the current season or the mini season. In both you can collect the rewards with the same tickets.

As with the other Mini Seasons, the rewards must be **redeemed one at a time**. First the **Shimmy Dance Emote** and then continue in order. Each reward states which other reward must be redeemed beforehand.

Tickets are earned as usual through the daily and weekly challenges.

![Mini Season: Sock Hop Mock Up](/uploads/nukaknights-post-miniseason-ingame-mockup-sock-hop.jpg)

*Note: German translations are not yet available.*
